sessions.summary: Investigated ITSM incident INC39517025 (Covestro, CDP→C4C integration). Customer requests certificate-based auth (mTLS) instead of username/password. Standard CDP C4C connector supports only username/password; mTLS is NOT available. Feature request, not roadmapped.

Implemented CXCDP-46058 test-first: connector upgrade refreshes retained V2 enrichment bindings via UpdateBinding. Added empty-mapping rejection on update, failure reason in upgrade message, rollback verified. 3 commits, functional tests green. Epic-owner review doc prepared.
